security_audit.summary: The Markdown backticks, local loopback URL, example environment field, and legacy method name are false positives rather than executable threats. The advanced workflow still creates a real medium-severity risk by disabling Dart VM service authentication during coverage collection.

remediation.issue: The manual workflow disables Dart VM service authentication.
remediation.suggestion: Keep authentication enabled when possible. Otherwise bind explicitly to loopback, limit exposure time, and terminate the service immediately after collection.

semantic_findings.title: Unauthenticated Dart VM Service
semantic_findings.description: The advanced workflow uses --disable-service-auth-codes while enabling the Dart VM service. Local processes could access a privileged debugging interface during collection.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The command explicitly disables service authentication and enables a VM service port. The collector uses loopback, limiting exposure but not removing local access risk.

content.value_statement: Coverage setup can be inconsistent across Dart and Flutter projects. This skill guides dependency setup, test execution, LCOV generation, and output validation.
actual_capabilities: Adds the Dart coverage package as a development dependency.
Runs automated coverage collection for Dart and Flutter tests.
Generates LCOV output from Dart VM coverage data.
Explains manual VM service collection for advanced metrics.
Validates expected coverage files and troubleshoots missing entries.
Applies line, block, and file coverage ignore directives.
limitations: The skill requires a working Dart or Flutter toolchain.
It does not create tests for uncovered application behavior.
Branch and function coverage require a compatible Dart VM version.
Manual collection temporarily exposes a local VM debugging service.

best_practices: Keep the coverage package under development dependencies.
Review test failures before trusting generated coverage percentages.
Bind manual VM services to loopback and retain authentication.
anti_patterns: Do not exclude testable code only to increase the coverage percentage.
Do not publish raw coverage artifacts containing sensitive source paths.
Do not expose an unauthenticated Dart VM service beyond loopback.

faq.question: Does this skill support both Dart and Flutter?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides dependency and coverage workflows for standard Dart projects and Flutter projects.

faq.question: What report format does it generate?
faq.answer: It generates LCOV output, normally at coverage/lcov.info, plus raw JSON coverage data when applicable.

faq.question: Can it collect branch and function coverage?
faq.answer: Yes, when the installed Dart VM supports the required flags.

faq.question: Why is a source file missing from coverage?
faq.answer: The file may not be imported or executed by tests. Generated or intentionally untestable files can use coverage ignore directives.

faq.question: Does the skill write tests?
faq.answer: No. It collects and formats coverage from an existing test suite.

faq.question: Is manual VM service collection secure?
faq.answer: It requires care. Keep authentication enabled, bind to loopback, and stop the service immediately after collection.
